title: My Arm's Big Adventure
start: Talk to Burntmeat in the kitchen of the Troll Stronghold.

items.t: Bucket (may be obtained during the quest)
Climbing Boots or rock climbing boots or Trollheim teleport
There is a Tool leprechaun available when and where the below items will be needed, and he sells them, so players will not need to carry these items with them for the duration of the quest.
Rake (can't be on the tool belt, may be obtained during the quest)
Seed dibber (can't be on the tool belt, may be obtained during the quest)
Spade (can't be on the tool belt, may be obtained during the quest)
Plant cure (or an additional supercompost; Cure Plant from the Lunar Spellbook will not work, may be obtained during the quest)

recommended.t: 61 Magic and runes for Trollheim Teleport
A bucket of compost or an additional supercompost

rewards.t: 5000 Farming XP (as well as 495 more, when My Arm harvests the goutweed)
Access to a disease-free herb patch on top of the Troll Stronghold.
Giant Roc is unlocked in Dominion Tower.

steps.t: Go to the Troll Stronghold, head south then downstairs into the kitchen.
Speak to Burntmeat. [Chat: Accept › 2 Alright, I'll lend him a hand.]
Talk to My Arm, east of Burntmeat.
Travel to Burthorpe and head north-west past Troll Invasion.
Climb the rocks and head east past the thrower trolls to reach the Death Plateau.
p: The Adventurer being cooked with his dragon armour scattered all over the floor.
Searching the cooking pot on Death Plateau.

steps.t: Search the cooking pot to obtain a goutweedy lump.

sub.t: If you receive the message "... but you can't reach very far into it.", use an empty bucket on the cooking pot.

steps.t: Return to the Troll Stronghold kitchen and speak to My Arm.
Once on the surface, talk to him near the farming patch.
Read the farming manual he gives you, then talk to him again.
Use the 3 buckets of ugthanki dung and 7 buckets of supercompost on the soil patch.
Talk to My Arm for a cutscene. [Chat: 1 This is My Arm. We'd like to go to Karamja.]
Talk to Captain Barnaby if you find yourself in Ardougne.
Talk to My Arm south-east of the Karamja lodestone. He is east of Jiminua's Jungle Store.
Talk to Murcaily, guarding the tree grove north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai. [Chat: 1 A troll called My Arm wants a favour...]
p: My Arm having a strange conversation with you on the boat to Tai Bwo Wannai, which is followed by many Dolphins and fish.
My Arm's location after you arrive at Brimhaven.

steps.t: A cutscene will play. Go through the dialogue.
Talk to My Arm south-east of the Karamja lodestone. Continue through the dialogue while on the boat.
Return to the roof of the Troll Stronghold where the soil patch was.
If you don't already have the farming tools, right-click talk to the Tool Leprechaun to buy some. [Chat: 4 Would you like to trade?]
Talk to My Arm.
Use the following items on him in order:

sub.t: Pick up and use the rake head on the rake handle, give him the assembled rake again.
Supercompost (optional but recommended). Without supercompost, the patch may become diseased and require curing. Regular compost and ultracompost have no effect.
If the patch becomes diseased, a plant cure

p: My Arm harasses Qutiedoll in his quest for goutweed.
My Arm defeats the village's strongest warrior, Jagbakoba, with a hefty punch.
My Arm demands goutweed from Murcaily.
My Arm sends a certain Drunken Dwarf flying.

steps.t: Defeat the Baby Roc after the cutscene.
p: A rather large Roc attacks, angered at the death of its offspring.

steps.t: Make sure to have a spade or buy one from the tool leprechaun now, to avoid any extra steps after the next cutscene.
Talk to My Arm.
Defeat the Giant Roc that appears after the cutscene.
Talk to My Arm.
Use a spade on him.

sub.t: If needed, you can get the leprechaun to come back by climbing the ladder down and up again.

p: My Arm gains a farming level.

steps.t: Return to Burntmeat in the stronghold's kitchen and talk to him.
Return to My Arm and speak with him.
Quest complete!

p: My Arm rakes his farming patch.
A player stunned by the Roc's special attack.
